summary: Belize. Parliamentary democracy (national assembly) under a constitutional monarchy; a commonwealth realm.
rulers: King CHARLES III (since 8 September 2022); represented by Governor-General Froyla TZALAM (since 27 May 2021); Prime Minister John BRICEÑO (since 12 November 2020)
government: parliamentary democracy (National Assembly) under a constitutional monarchy; a Commonwealth realm
